inputs.name: HubResponsesMiddleware.handle.response
inputs.description: The Response to harden: handle writes X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and Cache-Control into its headers in place, replacing any existing values of those names. Its headers must be mutable, because a Response with immutable headers, such as one returned by fetch(), makes the first Headers.set call throw a TypeError.

outputs.name: HubResponsesMiddleware.handle
outputs.description: The same Response object that was passed in, returned after the five headers are set; handle never builds a new Response, so the status, body and all other headers are unchanged.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when response has no headers (for example it is null or undefined), or when its headers are immutable, such as a Response returned by fetch(), which makes Headers.set throw. handle does not catch it, so the error propagates to the caller and no Response is returned.
